findings.title: FortiClient EMS CVE-2026-35616 — Pre-Auth API Bypass Exploited In-Wild to Push PowerShell Stealer Fleet-Wide
findings.summary: Pre-auth API bypass in FortiClient EMS lets attackers modify endpoint policies and push malicious PowerShell to every managed endpoint as legitimate operation; Arctic Wolf detected active in-wild exploitation in May 2026 dropping FortiEndpoint_Patch.exe Chromium/Gecko stealer, fixed in 7.4.7+.

findings.title: Gogs — Unpatched 0-Day RCE via Branch-Name Argument Injection into git rebase --exec (CVSS 9.4, MSF module)
findings.affected_technology: Gogs self-hosted Git platform (all supported builds; rebase-merge-enabled repos)
findings.summary: Authenticated user crafts a branch name that injects --exec into git rebase during 'Rebase before merging' pull-request merge, achieving RCE on the Gogs server; disclosed to maintainers 2026-03-17, unpatched as of 2026-05-28 public disclosure, with a Metasploit module available.

findings.title: Casdoor VU#780781 — Nine-CVE SAML/JWT/MFA Identity-Provider Bypass Batch, No Patch (CVE-2026-9090…9098)
findings.summary: CERT/CC VU#780781 details nine concurrent unpatched identity bypasses in Casdoor including arbitrary SAML signing-cert acceptance, MFA bypass via social-login binding, account takeover via unverified email, cross-org token exchange, SAML replay/audience/timing flaws, and missing JWT revocation checks; vendor coordination failed and no patches are available.

findings.title: Veeam Backup & Replication 13 + Service Provider Console — CVSS-9.4 MSP-Console Unauth Script Exec (CVE-2026-32996/32997/32998)
findings.affected_technology: Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.1, Veeam Service Provider Console ≤9.2.1, Veeam Agent for Windows
findings.summary: CVE-2026-32998 (CVSS 9.4) enables RCE on the multi-tenant VSPC via unsafe alarm-management script-exec parameters, CVE-2026-32997 (CVSS 8.6) lets Backup Admin write arbitrary files on Linux Veeam appliance, CVE-2026-32996 is Windows agent LPE; fixed in VBR 13.0.2.29 and VSPC 9.2.1.33875, no confirmed ITW yet but Veeam infrastructure is a top ransomware target.

findings.title: DAEMON Tools Lite Supply-Chain Compromise (CVE-2026-8398) — Signed Trojanized Installers + KEV-Added 2026-05-27
findings.affected_technology: DAEMON Tools Lite (Windows 12.5.0.2421–12.5.0.2434) signed by AVB Disc Soft
findings.summary: Attackers compromised AVB Disc Soft's official daemon-tools.cc distribution channel ~2026-04-08→2026-05-05, re-signing trojanized DTHelper/DiscSoftBusServiceLite/DTShellHlp binaries with the legitimate code-signing certificate; Kaspersky observed several thousand infections across 100+ countries and CISA added CVE-2026-8398 to KEV on 2026-05-27.

findings.title: GreyVibe (Russia-Aligned) — Industrial-Scale ChatGPT/Gemini/Ideogram-Powered Phishing + AI-Assisted RAT Development against Ukraine
findings.affected_technology: Threat-actor activity targeting Ukrainian gov/military/civilian/business orgs
findings.summary: BleepingComputer + SecurityWeek detail a likely-Russian threat cluster active since August 2025 that has scaled ChatGPT/Gemini/Ideogram AI usage to industrial levels for phishing lures and custom obfuscator/RAT development (LegionRelay, PhantomRelay, FallSpy, LOOKVALPS/JS, DAYLIGHT, TEASOUP), making AI-assistance baseline tradecraft across multi-geo threat clusters and obsoleting linguistic-quality phishing filters.

findings.title: TanStack + Nx Console KEV-Added 2026-05-27 (CVE-2026-45321 + CVE-2026-48027) — Federal Deadline 2026-06-10
findings.affected_technology: TanStack npm packages + Nx Console VS Code extension (Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2 cluster)
findings.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-45321 (TanStack OIDC/cache-poisoning supply-chain) and CVE-2026-48027 (Nx Console malicious extension v18.95.0 published briefly 2026-05-19) to KEV alongside CVE-2026-8398 on 2026-05-27, formalizing federal compliance pressure on the Wave 2 monetization paths previously covered 2026-05-21/22.

findings.title: Netherlands Stark Industries Seizure — Arrests Named: Andrey Nesterenko (MIRhosting) + Youssef Zinad (WorkTitans BV)
findings.summary: Krebs follow-up names the two arrested operators behind the 800+ servers seized 2026-05-27 across five Netherlands locations and maps their corporate structure to the PQHosting (sanctioned May 2025) → Stark Industries Solutions bulletproof-hosting lineage used for pro-Russian Danish-municipal-election attacks 2025-11-13→19.

noted.product: Apache Ignite REST HTTP default config

Stack buffer overflow in four AEAD decrypt_verify helpers (oss-security 2026-05-28); part of Perl crypto stack, expect ecosystem batch absorption.
Metric injection (oss-security 2026-05-28) — continues long-tail Perl/CPAN ecosystem batch pattern.
Header injection in request processing (oss-security 2026-05-28) — Perl PSGI middleware, niche.
Insecure RNG fallback when CSPRNG modules unavailable (oss-security 2026-05-26) — silently weakens KDF strength.
24-CVE file-format parser batch (oss-security 2026-05-28) — open-source chemistry toolkit, primarily client-side parsing, OOS unless exposed via SaaS file-conversion endpoints.
Privileged D-Bus service issues on Linux (oss-security 2026-05-26); local-only, OOS.
Local root via forged cifs.spnego upcall (oss-security 2026-05-28); LPE-only, OOS but absorb if container-escape primitive emerges.
Keystone credential-delegation/authz bypass + Neutron tagging-policy bypass (oss-security 2026-05-28); multi-tenant cloud platform authz bugs, impact depends on tenant model.

Stored XSS in widely-deployed editor (CVSS 8.7, dbugs PT-2026-44388, 2026-05-28); embedded in many SaaS admin panels, monitor for escalation.
NVD published HIGH-severity assignment 2026-05-28; already noted 2026-05-14 and severity-tier confirmation is not material change.
